name: same-mechanism-paraphrase
title: Taxi meter refusal

name: shared-transport-different-mechanisms
title: Closed attraction shopping diversion
description: A stranger falsely says an attraction is closed and offers a cheap tuk-tuk trip to commission-paying shops.
claim: A tuk-tuk driver demanded ten times the agreed fare at the end of the ride; there was no shopping trip or closure claim.

description: The Grand Palace was open on 2026-10-01 and claims that it was closed that day were false.
